summary: Concept webs — a hub in the centre with nodes on a circle around it and labelled lines between them, as a study diagram or as an assessment where the learner drags answers from a tray onto blank nodes and blank line labels. Succeeds L0169.
in_scope: Concept webs, concept maps, mind maps and graphic organizers laid out as a central hub with related ideas around it
Study webs with every node and line labelled and nothing to fill in
Drag-and-drop assessments where the learner fills blank nodes, the hub included, from a tray of answers
Relation labelling, where the learner fills the blank labels on the lines between nodes
Distractors — wrong answers mixed into either tray
Scoring with partial credit per blank, points per blank, and interchangeable blanks that accept each other's answers
Lines between any two nodes, with arrows or dashes, and labels on them
Node colours, shapes and sizes; math in $…$; images given by URL
The web an L0176 Learnosity custom question embeds with lang "0183"
out_of_scope: Flowcharts, timelines, trees, org charts and cycles drawn as a sequence — L0183 lays every web out as a hub and a circle, and does NOT support other layouts.
Learners adding nodes or drawing lines of their own is not built yet.
Venn diagrams are L0171; do NOT route them here.
Multiple choice, short answer, matching lists and other question types do NOT belong here — use L0180, or L0176 when the user names Learnosity.
Wrapping a web in a Learnosity item is L0176's job, never L0183's — L0183 produces the web that L0176 embeds.
L0183 does NOT accept L0169 programs: it is a different language, and existing L0169 items stay with L0169.
